zoe: Quick note  we need a lightweight 'quarantine' plan for GA traffic anomalies. Idea: short-term soft-quota + weekend hotfix window + public FAQ blurb. Owners?
matt: I'll draft the SLA micro-credits paragraph and explicit rollback criteria. Proposal: Paid 99.9% monthly, pilot customers get a 99.5 trial SLA. Rollback triggers: sustained error > 2% for 6m OR p95 > 600ms for 10m.
priya: Docs & AE: I'll own the FAQ blurb that explains soft-quotas and the early access ramp. Also a short 'what to tell customers' script for AE. ETA Tue EOD.
zoe: Ops asks: implement a temporary cost ceiling for autoscale during first 72h (cap at $Y/day) and a visible "launch budget" dashboard. Also limit extended trace retention to the launch project only.
matt: Canary plan: 3-stage ramp 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 3 hours with smoke tests. If canary fails, auto-fallback to quantized-small and ingress throttle to 30%. I'll PR the canary config.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary 2024-08-21T03:00Z. Smoke: 130rps for 18m. Auto-rollback: error_threshold: 0.03, window_s: 600.
priya: Support: recommend 48h reinforced coverage (12h overlaps). I'll post the rota and canned responses. Also adding an internal triage checklist for tokenization regressions and KV-warmup issues.
zoe: Risk callouts: (1) billing surprises from burst autoscale, (2) silent quality shifts on quantized paths, (3) miscommunication on Dedicated vs Hosted behavior. Actions: Matt -> SLA + canary config; Priya -> docs + AE script + rota; Zoe -> budget guardrails + launch dashboard. Confirm by EOD Fri.
matt: Ack. PRing SLA + canary in next 2hrs.
priya: Ack. Drafts coming.
